assertions.statement: Body paragraph spacing, indentation, line spacing and pagination controls are validated from YAML and emitted in DOCX styles.
Existing templates remain valid and preserve prior defaults when new P0 fields are omitted.
Chinese and English abstract and keyword paragraphs receive independent template-driven semantic styles.
TOC 1-3 styles contain configured indentation, spacing, page-number tab stops and leaders.
Inline citations support superscript mode and bibliography entries support configured hanging indentation and spacing.
Odd, even and first-page header/footer variants render real relationships, distances, borders and configurable page-number fields.
Semantic style roles are resolved before rendering and RenderPlan remains free of DOCX or OOXML implementation objects.
School-specific values are absent from renderer constants and all core commands remain offline and deterministic.
The complete P0 example builds into a valid editable DOCX whose package passes focused OOXML assertions.
The P0 example is reviewed in Microsoft Word or WPS for body, abstract, TOC, bibliography, header and page-number layout.
